scripts.text:
[Tourist]
You're that meanie...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你這個壞蛋......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Aren't you...?

[Tourist]
Alright, alright, but you don't have to be mean.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
好吧，好吧，你也沒必要這麼刻薄。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I didn't think you were that
mean. Scram, I ain't in the mood
to talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
沒想到你居然這麼壞。滾開，我現在沒心情跟你說話。

scripts.text: So do you have business in Lutie?
scripts.translation: 你來薑餅城有事嗎？

scripts.text: You don't want to go to Lutie for a tour.
scripts.translation: 你不想去薑餅城逛逛嗎？

scripts.text: What made you come over here?
scripts.translation: 是什麼讓你來到這裡？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Yes.
Well, actually...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
是的。
其實......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I wanted to give my girlfriend
some well baked cookies.
Sadly, in my hometown of
Morocc, we don't have fancy
foods like that.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我想給女朋友帶些烤得香噴噴的餅乾。可惜在我的家鄉夢羅克，沒有這麼精緻的點心。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've been asking all these
merchants about it, and I was
told that I could only get them
in Lutie...that's my story.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我問了這裡的商人，他們說只有薑餅城才買得到......事情就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Now I'm running out of money and
food...I can't stay here much longer...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
現在我的錢和食物都快用完了......我不能在這裡待太久......

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text: Well, good luck with everything.
scripts.translation: 祝你一切順利

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Thank god! Thank you so much.
I knew you would help me~!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
謝天謝地！太感謝你了。
我就知道你會幫我的~！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Umm...
Before we talk about that help...
Er, hmmmm...
Well, you know I'm pretty
much starving to death now...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
那個......
說到請你幫忙之前......
呃，嗯......
你看，我現在都快餓死了......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Could you please get me some Meat?
I know I'm asking you too much,
but I'm pretty much penniless
so I don't really have much
of a choice...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
能請你給我買些肉嗎？
我知道這樣要求有點過分，但我身無分文，實在別無選擇......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
.........
How could you be so cold
hearted after hearing my story?
...You're pretty mean!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
......
聽了我的故事，你怎麼能這麼冷酷無情？
......你也太壞了！

scripts.text:

...Oh really? Hmm...people said I
could only get the well baked
cookie in Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So I came here after searching
for Al De Baran...almost
killing myself when I passed the desert...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
所以我找遍艾爾帕蘭後才來到這裡......穿越沙漠時差點丟了性命。*嗚嗚*

I see...I can understand that you
can't help me. It's alright...
It's not like I have the right
to demand anything of you...
But...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我明白......我知道你幫不了我。沒關係......我也沒有資格要求你做什麼......不過......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Sob*...so... hungry...

[Tourist]
Ah...thanks! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊...謝謝！太感謝你了！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate that you're
helping me out of the
goodness of your heart,
but...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我很感激你出於好心幫助我，不過......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
What are you...
Cheap?! You can feed
a starving man more
than this...bring me
more Meat!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你這是什麼意思......小氣鬼？！
給一個快餓死的人吃這麼點東西怎麼夠？再給我帶些肉來！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate you bringing
all this for me but...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
謝謝你給我帶來這些，不過......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Geez, you want I should
choke myself to death?
I can't eat all of this!
Bring me less Meat, yeah?

天哪，你是想讓我撐死嗎？我吃不下這麼多！少帶點肉來，行嗎？

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Phew*...thanks.
At long last...
I feel stuffed.
...Oh. Right.
My girlfriend.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
*呼*......謝謝。
終於......
我吃飽了。
......啊，對了。
我女朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Er...about the well-baked
cookie I told you about? Um... I
know I'm being rude and selfish
...But I don't think I can find
it on my own.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
呃......我之前說的烤得香噴噴的餅乾......嗯......我知道自己這樣很沒禮貌、很自私......可我覺得靠自己可能找不到。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So, could you bring me ^0000FF20 Well-baked Cookies^000000?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
所以，能幫我帶^0000FF20塊烤得香噴噴的餅乾^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Although I shouldn't be asking for
any more favors, and you'd have
to go through all this trouble...
while I'd be safe over here...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
雖然我不該再麻煩你，而且你得費這麼大勁......我卻能在這裡安安穩穩地待著......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I really want to make my
girlfriend happy. Everything
would be worth it for
that smile on her face...
I just can't pass this chance up!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我真的想讓我女朋友開心。為了看到她臉上的笑容，一切都值得......我不能錯過這個機會！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Haven't you been in love...?
Surely you understand the
sway that this woman has
over me! Otherwise...I'd be
selling jewels...anything
other than this.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你沒談過戀愛嗎......？你肯定能理解這個女人對我的吸引力吧！
不然的話......我寧願去賣珠寶，也不想這麼折騰。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm begging you, since you're
stronger and less delicate
than me, please bring me
^0000FF20 Well-baked Cookies^000000!
For me, it's impossible!!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
求求你了，你比我強壯，也沒我那麼嬌氣，幫我帶來^0000FF20塊烤得香噴噴的餅乾^000000吧！
這事我根本辦不到！！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah~!! Thank you so much!!
There really are many good
people like you in this world.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊~！！太感謝你了！！
這個世界上果然有很多像你這樣的好人。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I appreciate what you've done for
me...now I can see her smile with
happiness.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我很感激你為我做的一切...現在我能看到她幸福的笑容了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmm, there is still one problem
left for me though...How do I
get back home to Morocc??
Well, if it can make my girl
happy...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嗯......不過還有個問題......我怎麼才能回到夢羅克呢？
唉，只要能讓她開心......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...I'll get around to it.
Sooner or later. Man,
that desert's really big,
you know?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
...我會想辦法的。
遲早的事。
天哪，這片沙漠真的很大啊，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I see...I can understand that you
can't help me. It's alright...
It's not like I have the right
to demand anything of you...
But...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我明白了...我理解你幫不了我。沒關係的...
我也沒資格要求你做什麼...
但是...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
非常感謝你！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmm...I wanna pay you back...
And you're an adventurer...
But I don't got any like...
magic armor or those
cards you guys are
always playing with...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嗯......我想報答你......而且你也是冒險者......
可我沒有什麼魔法裝備，也沒有你們常玩的那些卡片......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hmmm...
....I got it!
Sooner or later, you
wanna visit some sort
of wise man or...
...something, right?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嗯......
......我想到了！
遲早有一天，你會去拜訪某位智者或......
......什麼人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Visit my pal ^649664Jacob^000000 in
Morocc. Tell him that I
introduced you. He knows
about a wise man...
Though, he isn't one
himself...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
去夢羅克找我的朋友^649664雅各布^000000，告訴他是我介紹你來的。他認識一位智者......不過他自己可不是。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah, sorry, I haven't even told
you my name. My name is...
^0000FFPandger Mayer^000000.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊，抱歉，我還沒告訴你名字。我叫......
^0000FF潘傑·梅耶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So yeah, tell my pal Jacob
that Pandger Mayer introduced you.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
所以，告訴我的朋友雅各布，是潘傑·梅耶介紹你來的。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So...you tell 'em:
^0000FFPandger Mayer introduced you^000000
Exactly like that~
^0000FFPandger Mayer introduced you^000000
^FF0000Don't forget it~^000000
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你就這麼告訴他們：
^0000FF是潘傑·梅耶介紹你來的^000000
一字不差哦~
^0000FF是潘傑·梅耶介紹你來的^000000
^FF0000別忘了~^000000

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Sorry I can't pay you back with
more than this, though. Kinda
stinks, huh?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
抱歉，我只能用這些來報答你了。
有點寒酸，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Here, take this as an extra
token of my gratitute.
This doohickey has been
pretty handy in sticky
situations...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
拿著，這個算是額外的謝禮。
這個小玩意在棘手的情況下還挺管用......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hopefully, it'll be useful.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
希望它能派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hopefully, it'll be useful.
Umm...it seems you're carrying too much stuff with you.
Doncha want me to help you?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
希望它能派上用場。
嗯......看來你帶的東西太多了。要不要我幫你減輕負重？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Heh...once gain, thanks for
the help. Take care, guy.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿...再次感謝你的幫助。
保重，老兄。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help. Anyways...now I remember
I gotta go back through the
desert again...*Sigh*
Yeah, I better get back...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，多謝你幫忙。對了......我想起來了，我還得再穿過沙漠回去......唉，我還是得回去了......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...no matter how hard it is.
But...yeah. It's gonna be pretty
hard. Crossing the desert...
alone. By myself...crud.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
......不管有多難。
但......是啊，會很艱難。獨自一個人穿越沙漠......真糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help....I ain't sure if I
can make it back to Morocc
in one piece...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，多謝你幫忙......我不確定自己能不能平安回到夢羅克......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
But I better go back
to my girlfriend. That's
the point of me coming
here in the first place,
anyway.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
但我得回到我女朋友身邊。
這就是我來的目的，無論如何。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks a bunch for your
help. Man...Morocc is a long
way off, isn't it? Aw nuts...
I guess if I was crazy
enough to come here because
of my girlfriend...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，多謝你幫忙。夢羅克離這兒可真遠啊......糟了，既然我為了女朋友都敢跑來這裡......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm crazy enough to walk all
way back to Morocc...
...
...unless...
You'll gimme a piggy-back ride?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
那我也敢一路走回夢羅克......
......
......除非......
你願意揹我一程？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
...kidding. I'm not that
big of a jerk, I guess.
Try not to look so
surprised!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
......開玩笑的。我想我還沒那麼混蛋。
別一臉驚訝！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Where am I...?
...Who am I?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我在哪裡...？
...我是誰？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
.....

[Tourist]
Mahahahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
*Drools*...I love chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
*流口水*......我愛巧克力！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Wait...
I have a girlfriend...
and...and...
cookies...?
I feel sooo lost...
^3355FFWe don't talk to crazy people~^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF我們才不跟瘋子說話呢~^000000

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Where am I?
*Sob*...I guess I got lost...
Hey, where is this!?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我在哪裡？
*嗚嗚*......我好像迷路了......
喂，這裡是哪裡？！

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text: This is Alberta.
scripts.translation: 這裡是艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: This is Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 這裡是艾爾帕蘭

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ah...I see. So this is
Alberta...crud. I'm
supposed to go to ^0000FFLutie^000000...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊......原來如此。
這裡是艾爾貝塔......該死，我本來應該去^0000FF薑餅城^000000的......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, thanks for letting me know.
Now at least I know where I am.
Geez...they got boats here
that go everywhere, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，謝謝你告訴我。至少我現在知道自己在哪兒了。

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:

Pandger Mayer introduced you.

[{0}]
潘傑·梅耶介紹你來的。

scripts.translation:

哦，你是說那個陷入愛河的傢伙？
上次見到他時，他正要去某個地方找餅乾......

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

那麼告訴我，女士。他是不是騙我了？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[湯米]
那麼告訴我，先生。他是不是騙我了？

等等......等等，湯米，那不是真的......

scripts.translation:

到底能不能用這個抓到殭屍啊？
告訴我嘛~~~！

scripts.translation:

嘿嘿！我就知道！
謝謝你~！！！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Now I can have a Munak!
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
現在我可以有一隻殭屍了！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
(...*Phew* Thank you~)
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
(...*呼* 謝謝你~)

scripts.text:

I knew it!! Daddy, you're a liar!!
scripts.translation:

我就知道！！爸爸，你是個騙子！！

scripts.text:

I hate you...I hate you!!!

我討厭你......我討厭你！！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Sigh*...that's my boy. Please get me a No Recipient as soon as you can!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*嘆氣*...那是我的兒子。請儘快幫我弄一封魔物信件！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
^FF0000Munak Munak Munak Munak!!^000000
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
^FF0000殭屍殭屍殭屍殭屍！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....*Sigh* Okay.
I will give you a chance
to make up for your mistake.
Please get me a No Recipient as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
......唉，好吧。
我給你個機會彌補自己的錯誤。
請儘快幫我弄一封魔物信件。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
....I don't want to talk to YOU
anymore. Get outta here~!
It's your fault my little
boy thinks I'm a big liar!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
...我再也不想和你說話了。
快滾~！
都怪你，讓我兒子覺得我是個超級大騙子！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Phew* Now I can leave him alone.
Kids nowadays are so impatient...I am worried about my son.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*呼*，總算能讓他自己待會兒了。
現在的孩子真沒耐心......我很擔心我兒子。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
However, I can't do anything
about his temper...I think
he's just too young to know
what he's doing.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
不過，我也管不了他的脾氣......我想他只是太小，還不知道自己在做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I'm having a hard time trying to
be a good parent, and I'm
beginning to appreciate my
own parents' efforts to raise me.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
努力做個好父親真不容易，我也開始體會到父母當年養育我的辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Respect your parents while they're
still alive. It's too late to be
sorry after you've lost them.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
趁父母還在世時要尊敬他們。
失去他們之後再後悔就太晚了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I was a wild kid as well...my
parents had a hard time raising
me. I'm ashamed of what I've done
when I was young...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我小時候也很調皮......父母為養育我吃了不少苦。
我真後悔年輕時做過的那些事......

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Those days, my parents couldn't
afford to feed me three meals a
day. And there were many
creditors that always came
to our house early
early in the morning.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
那時候，我父母連一日三餐都供不起。
而且總有很多債主一大早就上門。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
Have you every heard about
distraint-papers? As soon
as those creditors put that
distraint-paper on any of my
things,it would no longer be
mine.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
你聽說過扣押單嗎？債主只要把扣押單貼在我的東西上，那件東西就不再屬於我了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
I hated my parents for not providing me with a sweet home,
and I became rebellious.
But, no matter how bad I was,
Even in those difficult circumstances...
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我恨父母沒能給我一個溫馨的家，於是變得叛逆。
可無論我多麼不懂事，即使在那樣艱難的日子裡......

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
They never gave up on me.
Later, they told me that I was their one and only hope...
even though I was more of a burden than anything else at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
他們從未放棄過我。後來他們告訴我，我是他們唯一的希望......
儘管當時的我只會給他們添麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]

scripts.translation:
[湯米]
爸爸，你知道自己已經講過這個故事幾百遍了嗎？*噗~*

^3355FFTommy was jumping and running
around like a crazy rabbit and
eventually bumped against me.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF湯米像只瘋兔子一樣上躥下跳，最後撞到了我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
...Tommy, respect your dad.

[雅各布]

這是你爸爸的人生故事。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
A.aa.aand.!!!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
啊、啊、啊——！！！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]

scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我告訴過你多少次了，在別人面前要守規矩？！

[Jacob]
Say you're sorry to her!
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
向她道歉！

scripts.text:
[Jacob]

[雅各布]
向他道歉！

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
*Piff~*

scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
我沒聽到~！！

[雅各布]
啊~對了！你剛才說是潘傑·梅耶介紹你來的吧？
他可不會隨便把我介紹給別人。哦，你一定是......冒險者。

[Jacob]

scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
沒錯。
我有件事要告訴你。

[Jacob]

pass through a cave, you will
arrive at a town called Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
當你從夢羅克往西走，穿過一個洞穴，就會到達一個叫克魔島的城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]

scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
到了那裡，你會見到一位名叫^0000FF克里克長老^000000的老人。

[Jacob]

[雅各布]
人們說，許多冒險者都因為某些原因去拜訪這位老人。
你不妨去和他談談，看看他是否有什麼智慧可以傳授給你？

[{0}]

this one thing:

[雅各布]

'^0000FFBe good to other people.^000000'
'^0000FFTry to be in someone else's shoes before judging that person.^000000'

misbehaves.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
看來他通過這段經歷學到了一些東西。
他不再要求我做不到的事，也不再胡鬧了。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
That was another favor you did for me, even if you didn't mean to. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
這也是你幫我的另一個忙，儘管你並非有意為之。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Jacob]
*Yawns*....
Today is such a boring day~.
I guess I'd better go take a walk
with my son. Do you want to walk with me?
scripts.translation:
[雅各布]
*打哈欠*......
今天真無聊~
我還是帶兒子出去走走吧。你要一起嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jacob's son]
I'm happy to hear that, daddy~
scripts.translation:
[雅各布的兒子]
聽你這麼說，我很高興，爸爸~

scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！ -
- 你目前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Good day, adventurer.
What kind of business
do you have with me?
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
日安，冒險者。
你有什麼事找我？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Are you seeking fortune or
mental relief? If not, do
you wish to finish something
you've started?
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你是來求財，還是尋求心靈慰藉？
如果不是，你是想完成某件未竟之事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Answer me, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
回答我，冒險者！

scripts.text: I seek fortune!
scripts.translation: 我尋求財富！

scripts.text: I seek...wisdom.
scripts.translation: 我尋求...智慧

scripts.text: I want to finish what I've started.
scripts.translation: 我想完成自己開始的事

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're honest...!
However, I suggest that you try not to be enamored with wealth.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你很誠實...！
不過，我建議你不要過於迷戀財富。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do you know the exact meaning
of the old saying...
^0000FFToo much is as bad as too little^000000?
I will give you what you want if
you answer the way I expect you to.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你知道這句老話的確切含義嗎？
^0000FF過猶不及^000000。
如果你能給出我期望的答案，我就給你想要的東西。

scripts.text: It's necessary to have a lot!
scripts.translation: 擁有很多是必要的！

scripts.text: Too dumb to see the future.
scripts.translation: 太愚蠢，看不到未來

scripts.text: Too much of a good thing can be bad.
scripts.translation: 好事過頭也會變壞

scripts.text: Cringe to the powerful.
scripts.translation: 向強者卑躬屈膝

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...
Get out of my sight,
you greedy fool.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
...
滾出我的視線，你這個貪婪的蠢貨。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Bah! The more ignorant they are, the more arrogantly they act!
Did you think that I would accept just any meaning?
Take care, you ignorant fool.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
哼！越無知的人，越愛擺出傲慢的樣子！
你以為我會接受隨便什麼解釋嗎？
保重了，無知的蠢貨。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's right. You know it pretty
well. That adage serves as a lesson in greed.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
沒錯，你很明白這個道理。
這句諺語正是對貪婪的告誡。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
There is a man I've known for a
long time...he was so greedy for
money and fortune, he didn't care what other people thought of him.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我認識一個人......他曾經極其貪財，完全不在乎別人怎麼看他。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Consequently, people around him
didn't like him at all. In the end, he lost his friends due to his greed.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
結果，周圍的人都很討厭他。
最終，他因為貪婪而失去了朋友。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Of course, this rule applies to
you as well. That sort of thing is a universal principle, after all.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
當然，這個道理也適用於你。
畢竟，這是一種普遍的原則。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....
Did you think that I would accept just any meaning??
Take care, you ignorant fool.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
......
你以為我會接受隨便什麼解釋嗎？
保重了，無知的蠢貨。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I see. I have been trying to help
other people who need advice in
order to improve their lives.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我明白了。
我一直試圖幫助那些需要建議的人，以改善他們的生活。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Since you need my advice
as well, I will try to
impart my wisdom in a
way that you will understand.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
既然你也需要我的建議，我會試著用你能理解的方式傳授我的智慧。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Now, tell me what is bothering right now.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
現在告訴我，是什麼在困擾你。

scripts.text: Boy/girlfriend issue.
scripts.translation: 戀愛問題

scripts.text: Financial problem.
scripts.translation: 經濟問題

scripts.text: Bored to death.
scripts.translation: 無聊透頂

scripts.text: Career issue.
scripts.translation: 職業問題

scripts.text: I want money.
scripts.translation: 我想要錢

scripts.text: Give me items, old man.
scripts.translation: 給我物品，老頭

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm envious of you! Still, young
folk like you are lucky to
have such problems...sadly,
no one but yourself can really
help you in those kinds of
situations...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我羨慕你！不過，年輕人有這樣的煩惱也是幸運的......遺憾的是，這種事只有你自己才能解決......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, the advice I can give you
is this: Be honest with your
beloved. One lie leads to
another lie in no time.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
不過，我能給你的建議是：對你所愛的人誠實。
一個謊言會迅速導致另一個謊言。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If you treat the person you love
as special to you, that person
will eventually come to
understand your feelings...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
如果你把所愛的人放在心上，對方終究會理解你的心意......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
And, remember this...
Everyone has a different way of showing that they love someone.
So...don't be discouraged if your feelings aren't returned.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
還有，請記住......
每個人表達愛意的方式都不一樣。
所以，如果你的心意沒有得到回應，也不要氣餒。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But still, I believe being honest
is the best way to gain your
true love.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
不過，我依然相信，誠實是獲得真愛最好的方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....well, that is all I can tell
you. I hope you will be happy
with that nugget of wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
......好了，我能告訴你的就這些了。
希望這點小小的智慧能讓你開心。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...yes, everybody has their own
financial problems. However, think of it in this way:
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
...是的，每個人都有自己的經濟問題。
不過，你可以這樣想：

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Money is important to make
a living, but it's not what life is all about.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
金錢對於謀生很重要，但它並不是生活的全部。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Some may have the life goal of
making fortunes, but I don't think it's the happiest way of living.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
有些人的人生目標是發大財，但我不認為這是最幸福的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
As you see, there are powerful
people in this world who can control our lives. But oftentimes...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
正如你所見，這個世界上有能掌控我們命運的強大人物。
但很多時候...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
They are too greedy to be in that
position and they don't have
their priorities straight.
Instead of improving the world, they use their power to only help themselves.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
他們身居高位卻過於貪婪，分不清輕重緩急。
他們不致力於改善世界，反而只利用權力來謀取私利。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If I were them, I wouldn't want to
rule the world in that way.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
如果我是他們，我也不想以這種方式統治世界。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Don't you think we need somebody who can change this world??
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你不覺得我們需要有人來改變這個世界嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....I apologize for being short
tempered. I just wanted to let
you know that money is not everything. But, it is something you need to live.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
...抱歉我剛才有些急躁。
我只是想讓你知道，金錢並非一切。
但它是生存所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm aware that greedy people
ridicule this belief, saying
that it is a poor man's effort
to protect his pride.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我知道貪婪的人會嘲笑這種信念，說這只是窮人為了維護自尊而做的徒勞努力。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But, I still believe I am right.
After all...I am a Sage.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
但我依然堅信自己是對的。
畢竟...我是一名賢者。
希望你能從我的忠告中獲得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, we always need to be
entertained. But...it
seems you may not be satisfied with anything.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
是的，我們總需要一些娛樂。不過......看來沒有什麼能讓你滿意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's all about the various tastes
and interests people will have.
Things other people enjoy might not
displease you. Also, if your
mind is unwilling to be happy,
you will not enjoy life.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
這要看每個人的品味和興趣。別人喜歡的東西，你未必喜歡。
而且，如果你自己不願意快樂，就無法享受人生。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Here's an example of having
the right frame of mind.
Let's say we're cleaning
the street for the town,
which can be hard, grueling work...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
心態不同，感受也會不同。
比如說，我們在為城鎮清掃街道，這可能是一項艱苦繁重的工作......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're always covered in dust.
In the summer, your body is
sticky with sweat...
In the winter, you'll be
be out in the freezing cold...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你總是滿身灰塵。
夏天，汗水會讓你渾身黏膩......
冬天，你又得在刺骨的寒風中工作......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, even so, it will be different to someone with a different perspective.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
然而，即便如此，對於擁有不同視角的人來說，感受也會截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Ideally, we should try
to find joy in making
other people happy.
By cleaning the street, we can
give others a reason to smile.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
理想情況下，我們應該試著從讓別人快樂中找到樂趣。
通過清掃街道，我們可以給別人一個微笑的理由。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Tourists passing through the street
can enjoy its cleanliness...
Overall, it makes the entire community look good.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
遊客路過時能欣賞整潔的街道......
總的來說，這會讓整個社群顯得更美好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If your parents see you cleaning
the street, they will be proud of
their child.
...But now, I think I'm beginning to make no sense.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
如果父母看到你在清掃街道，他們會為你感到驕傲。
......不過，我想我開始說得沒邊了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Oh well, I apologize.
Just try to think positively.
With the right attitude, eventually you will find something to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
算了，抱歉。
試著往積極的一面想吧。
只要心態正確，你終會找到值得享受的事物。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Haha~ I can see you're just
clicking the 'next' button on these
windows, because you're sick and tired of this NPC conversation.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
哈哈~我看你只是在點窗口裡的“下一步”，因為你已經受夠這種NPC對話了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....anyway, that is all.
I hope you will be happy
with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
......總之，就說到這裡。
希望我的忠告能讓你開心。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's an agonizing thought for every young person.
But you have a lot time to think about what you want to do in the future.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
這是每個年輕人都會為之苦惱的問題。
不過，你還有大把時間思考自己將來想做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Experience more in many different
places, and read as many books
as you can. Focus on broadening your perspective.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
願你享受人生。記住，時光飛逝，人生只有一次。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Then, you will realize what you really want to do.
....that's all I can say.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我一直通過提供建議，幫助人們改善生活。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....
I see, you chose the wrong answer in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
......看來你一開始就選錯了答案。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I believe this will be a lesson to be more honest with yourself.
Choose the right answer next time!
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
希望這能讓你學會對自己誠實。
下次選對答案！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You rascal!
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你這小無賴！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Get out of my sight immediately! I don't talk to trash!
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
立刻從我眼前消失！
我不跟垃圾說話！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, you need to see things to the end.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
是的，你需要把事情堅持到底。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....*Sigh* Okay.
I forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
......唉，好吧。
我原諒你了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I do not wish to continue this conversation with you.
Get out of my sight immediately!
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我不想再和你談下去了。
立刻從我眼前消失！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...I was just testing you
in order to give you something
special. I'm the only person in the world that can give you this...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
......我剛才只是在考驗你，想把一樣特別的東西給你。
我是世上唯一能給你這件東西的人......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I had to check if you are the right person as I initially thought.
....Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我得確認你是否真如我最初想的那樣，是合適的人選。
......嗯。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But you don't expect me to give something special without any compensation, do you?
Would you bring the items I want?
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
但你不會指望我不索取任何報酬就給你特別的東西吧？
你願意幫我帶點東西來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's not a hard thing to do.
That is...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
這並不難。
那就是......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
10 Brigan,
15 Clam Shell,
10 Crab Shell
and 50 Cyfar.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
10個布里刊，
15個蛤蜊外殼，
10個螃蟹外殼，
以及50個賽依伐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Well, I am collecting those as my hobby.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
嗯，我收集這些是我的愛好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I have no doubt that you will be able to gather them all.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我相信你一定能把它們全部收集齊。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do me this favor, young man.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
請幫個忙，年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....hmm. I see you want more.
Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
...嗯，看來你還想要更多。
請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Is there any business left between
us? Tell me, young adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我們之間還有什麼事嗎？
說吧，年輕的冒險者......

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou feel there may be something you missed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你感覺似乎有什麼東西被遺漏了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I see you know how the world
works. When you need something
from someone, you must give
in order to receive.
Thank you for your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
看來你很懂世間的道理。
想要從別人那裡得到什麼，就必須先給予。
謝謝你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Please, take this first.
If you would, please go talk to my
grandson later. He seemed to witness something horrible a while ago...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
請先收下這個。
之後請去和我的孫子談談。他剛才似乎目睹了什麼可怕的事......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I have no idea what he saw,
because the shock took away
his ability to speak.
When he recovers, I will tell you.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我不知道他看到了什麼，因為巨大的衝擊讓他失去了說話的能力。
等他恢復後，我會告訴你的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
In fact, the items I have asked
for will be used to cure
his condition. I don't
really collect these as a
hobby...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
其實，我讓你收集的那些物品，是用來治療他的。
我並不是真的把它們當作愛好來收集......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I am sorry to cause you
much trouble for my own good.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
為了我自己的事給你添了這麼多麻煩，我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Remember, when you want something,
especially when it's special, you
should always offer something in exchange.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
記住，想要得到某樣東西，尤其是特別的東西，就應該拿出東西來交換。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I want...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我想要...

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
10 Brigan,
15 Clam Shell,
10 Crab Shell and
50 Cyfar.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
10個布里刊，
15個蛤蜊外殼，
10個螃蟹外殼，
以及50個賽依伐。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Feel free to come back anytime...
And if you need advice, I am more than willing to help you.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
隨時歡迎回來......
需要建議的話，我很樂意幫你。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Do you wish for me to give you advice, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你想讓我給你一些建議嗎，冒險者？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Now, tell me what bothers you at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
現在，告訴我你目前有什麼煩惱。

scripts.text: Boy/girlfriend issue.
scripts.translation: 戀愛問題

scripts.text: Financial problem.
scripts.translation: 經濟問題

scripts.text: Bored to death.
scripts.translation: 無聊透頂

scripts.text: Career issue.
scripts.translation: 職業問題

scripts.text: Give me items, old man.
scripts.translation: 給我物品，老頭

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm envious of you! Still, young
folk like you are lucky to
have such problems...sadly,
no one but yourself can really
help you in those kinds of
situations...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我羨慕你！不過，年輕人有這樣的煩惱也是幸運的......遺憾的是，這種事只有你自己才能解決......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, the advice I can give you
is this: Be honest with your
beloved. One lie leads to
another lie in no time.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
不過，我能給你的建議是：對你所愛的人誠實。
一個謊言會迅速導致另一個謊言。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If you treat the person you love
as special to you, that person
will eventually come to
understand your feelings...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
如果你把所愛的人放在心上，對方終究會理解你的心意......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
And, remember this...
Everyone has a different way of showing that they love someone.
So...don't be discouraged if your feelings aren't returned.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
還有，請記住......
每個人表達愛意的方式都不一樣。
所以，如果你的心意沒有得到回應，也不要氣餒。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But still, I believe being honest
is the best way to gain your
true love.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
不過，我依然相信，誠實是獲得真愛最好的方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....well, that is all I can tell
you. I hope you will be happy
with that nugget of wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
......好了，我能告訴你的就這些了。
希望這點小小的智慧能讓你開心。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
...yes, everybody has their own
financial problems. However, think of it in this way:
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
...是的，每個人都有自己的經濟問題。
不過，你可以這樣想：

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Money is important to make
a living, but it's not what life is all about.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
金錢對於謀生很重要，但它並不是生活的全部。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Some may have the life goal of
making fortunes, but I don't think it's the happiest way of living.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
有些人的人生目標是發大財，但我不認為這是最幸福的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
As you see, there are powerful
people in this world who can control our lives. But oftentimes...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
正如你所見，這世上有些強大的人能掌控我們的生活。但很多時候......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
They are too greedy to be in that
position and they don't have
their priorities straight.
Instead of improving the world, they use their power to only help themselves.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
他們身居高位卻過於貪婪，分不清輕重緩急。
他們不致力於改善世界，反而只利用權力來謀取私利。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If I were them, I wouldn't want to
rule the world in that way.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
如果我是他們，我也不想以這種方式統治世界。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Don't you think we need somebody who can change this world??
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你不覺得我們需要有人來改變這個世界嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
.....I apologize for being short
tempered. I just wanted to let
you know that money is not everything. But, it is something you need to live.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
...抱歉我剛才有些急躁。
我只是想讓你知道，金錢並非一切。
但它是生存所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I'm aware that greedy people
ridicule this belief, saying
that it is a poor man's effort
to protect his pride.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
我知道貪婪的人會嘲笑這種信念，說這只是窮人為了維護自尊而做的徒勞努力。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
But, I still believe I am right.
After all...I am a Sage.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
但我依然堅信自己是對的。
畢竟...我是一名賢者。
希望你能從我的忠告中獲得幸福。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Yes, we always need to be
entertained. But...it seems
you may not be satisfied
with anything.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
是的，我們總需要一些娛樂。不過......看來沒有什麼能讓你滿意。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
It's all about the various tastes
and interests people will have.
Things other people enjoy might
displease you. Also, if your
mind is unwilling to be happy,
you will not enjoy life.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
這要看每個人的品味和興趣。別人喜歡的東西，你未必喜歡。
而且，如果你自己不願意快樂，就無法享受人生。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Here's an example of having
the right frame of mind.
Let's say we're cleaning
the street for the town,
which can be hard, grueling work...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
心態不同，感受也會不同。
比如說，我們在為城鎮清掃街道，這可能是一項艱苦繁重的工作......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You're always covered in dust.
In the summer, your body is
sticky with sweat...
In the winter, you'll be
be out in the freezing cold...
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你總是滿身灰塵。
夏天，汗水會讓你渾身黏膩......
冬天，你又得在刺骨的寒風中工作......

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
However, even so, it will be different to someone with a different perspective.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
然而，即便如此，對於擁有不同視角的人來說，感受也會截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Ideally, we should try
to find joy in making
other people happy.
By cleaning the street, we can
give others a reason to smile.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
理想情況下，我們應該試著從讓別人快樂中找到樂趣。
通過清掃街道，我們可以給別人一個微笑的理由。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Tourists passing through the
street can enjoy its
cleanliness...
Overall, it makes the entire community look good.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
遊客路過時能欣賞整潔的街道......
總的來說，這會讓整個社群顯得更美好。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
If your parents see you cleaning
the street, they will be proud of
their child.
...But now, I think I'm beginning to make no sense.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
如果父母看到你在清掃街道，他們會為你感到驕傲。
......不過，我想我開始說得沒邊了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Oh well, I apologize.
Just try to think positively.
With the right attitude, eventually you will find something to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
算了，抱歉。
試著往積極的一面想吧。
只要心態正確，你終會找到值得享受的事物。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Haha~ I can see you're just
clicking the 'next' button on
these windows, because you're sick and tired of this NPC conversation.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
哈哈~我看你只是在點窗口裡的“下一步”，因為你已經受夠這種NPC對話了。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
....anyway, that is all.
I hope you will be happy
with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
......總之，就說到這裡。
希望我的忠告能讓你開心。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
That's an agonizing thought for every young person.
But you have a lot time to think about what you want to do in the future.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
這對每個年輕人來說都是個令人苦惱的問題。
不過，你還有大把時間思考自己將來想做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Experience more in many different
places, and read as many books
as you can. Focus on broadening your perspective.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
去不同的地方多體驗，多讀書。
專注於拓寬你的視野。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Then, you will realize what you really want to do.
....that's all I can say.
I hope you will be happy with my wise advice.
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
那樣，你就會明白自己真正想做什麼。
...我能說的就這些了。
希望我的忠告能讓你感到快樂。

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
You rascal!
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
你這小無賴！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
Get out of my sight immediately! I don't talk to trash!
scripts.translation:
[克里克長老]
立刻從我眼前消失！
我不跟垃圾說話！

scripts.text:
[Elder Creek]
I hope you will enjoy your life. Remember, time flies and you live only once.
scripts.translation:

願你享受你的生活。
記住，時光飛逝，人生只有一次。

I have been helping people by giving them advice to improve their lives.
